mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM voice_audit_log WHERE voice_asset_id = #{voiceAssetId, typeHandler=com.echoes.voice.domain.voice.repository.typehandler.UUIDTypeHandler} ORDER BY ts DESC

SELECT

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO voice_audit_log ( audit_id, voice_asset_id, actor_user_id, action, result, details, ts ) VALUES ( #{auditId, typeHandler=com.echoes.voice.domain.voice.repository.typehandler.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{voiceAssetId, typeHandler=com.echoes.voice.domain.voice.repository.typehandler.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{actorUserId, typeHandler=com.echoes.voice.domain.voice.repository.typehandler.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{action}, #{result}, CASE WHEN #{details} IS NULL OR #{details} = '' THEN NULL WHEN JSON_VALID(#{details}) THEN CAST(#{details} AS JSON) ELSE JSON_OBJECT('message', #{details}) END, #{ts} )
